name: mcp-server
concept: a server that hosts tools and flows for MCP clients

issues.visual_description: 2 stroke(s) shorter than 1.5 device px at 16px (e3-line, e4-line): sub-pixel detail smudges
issues.fix_instruction: drop the detail or enlarge it to at least 2 grid units

issues.visual_description: parallel strokes e1-rect and e3-line are 1.0px apart (0.7 device px at 16px): they fuse
issues.fix_instruction: space parallel strokes at least 1.5 grid units apart (centre to centre minus the stroke width)
